Delete sale dialog title (moves the sale to Trash).

english: {invoice} moves to Trash and its stock goes back on the shelf. If it was sold on credit, the client's debt is removed too. You can undo this now or restore it from Trash for 30 days.
kiswahili: {invoice} inahamishiwa Tupio na bidhaa zake zinarudi rafuni. Kama yaliuzwa kwa mkopo, deni la mteja linaondolewa pia. Unaweza kutendua sasa au kuyarejesha kutoka Tupio ndani ya siku 30.
notes: Delete sale dialog text when no money was received.

english: {invoice} moves to Trash and its stock goes back on the shelf. If it was sold on credit, the client's debt is removed too. Money already received ({paid}) stays in your payments. You can undo this now or restore it from Trash for 30 days.
kiswahili: {invoice} inahamishiwa Tupio na bidhaa zake zinarudi rafuni. Kama yaliuzwa kwa mkopo, deni la mteja linaondolewa pia. Pesa iliyokwisha pokelewa ({paid}) inabaki kwenye malipo yako. Unaweza kutendua sasa au kuyarejesha kutoka Tupio ndani ya siku 30.
notes: Delete sale dialog text when money was received; paid is pre-formatted money.
Message after deleting a sale (with Undo).
Message after a sale is restored (Undo or Trash).

english: Stock, debt and client balance are updated.
kiswahili: Akiba, deni na salio la mteja vimesasishwa.
notes: Second line after a sale is restored.
Title when a sale cannot be restored; the reason is the second line.
Delete service dialog title (moves the service to Trash).

english: {invoice} moves to Trash, its stock goes back, and its debt and its expense are removed until you restore it. You can undo this now or restore it from Trash for 30 days.
kiswahili: {invoice} inahamishiwa Tupio, bidhaa zake zinarudi stoo, na deni lake na gharama yake vinaondolewa hadi utakapoirejesha. Unaweza kutendua sasa au kuirejesha kutoka Tupio ndani ya siku 30.
notes: Delete service dialog text when no money was received.

english: {invoice} moves to Trash, its stock goes back, and its debt and its expense are removed until you restore it. Money already received ({paid}) stays in your payments. You can undo this now or restore it from Trash for 30 days.
kiswahili: {invoice} inahamishiwa Tupio, bidhaa zake zinarudi stoo, na deni lake na gharama yake vinaondolewa hadi utakapoirejesha. Pesa iliyokwisha pokelewa ({paid}) inabaki kwenye malipo yako. Unaweza kutendua sasa au kuirejesha kutoka Tupio ndani ya siku 30.
notes: Delete service dialog text when money was received; paid is pre-formatted money.
Message after a service is restored (Undo or Trash).

english: Stock, debt, expense and client balance are updated.
kiswahili: Akiba, deni, gharama na salio la mteja vimesasishwa.
notes: Second line after a service is restored.
Title when a service cannot be restored; the reason is the second line.

english: This item was deleted before the update. Check its stock afterwards.
kiswahili: Kipengee hiki kilifutwa kabla ya sasisho. Kagua akiba yake baadaye.
notes: Extra line after restoring a sale or service deleted by the old version.

english: Not enough {product} in stock: {needed} needed, {available} left. Add stock first.
kiswahili: Hakuna {product} ya kutosha stoo: zinahitajika {needed}, zimebaki {available}. Ongeza akiba kwanza.
notes: Why a restore was refused: the stock does not cover a product. product is the stored item name.
Why a restore was refused: the client was deleted.
Why a restore was refused: a product was deleted. product is the stored item name.

english: Your account was created, but we could not sign you in automatically. Please sign in with your email and password.
kiswahili: Akaunti yako imefunguliwa, lakini hatukuweza kukuingiza moja kwa moja. Tafadhali ingia kwa barua pepe na nenosiri lako.
notes: Register: the account was made but the automatic sign-in after it failed (AuthService, AccountCreatedException).

english: Too many wrong invite codes. Wait {minutes, plural, =1{1 minute} other{{minutes} minutes}} and try again.
kiswahili: Misimbo mingi ya mwaliko si sahihi. Subiri {minutes, plural, =1{dakika 1} other{dakika {minutes}}} kisha ujaribu tena.
notes: Shown when the server refuses invite codes after too many wrong ones (P1 rate limit). minutes is the server's window, AppRules.inviteAttemptWindowMinutes.
Heading of the Update required screen (minimum app version gate).

english: This version of {appName} ({current}) can no longer be used. Please update to version {minimum} or later.
kiswahili: Toleo hili la {appName} ({current}) haliwezi kutumika tena. Tafadhali sasisha hadi toleo {minimum} au jipya zaidi.
notes: Update required screen. current is the running version, minimum the lowest one allowed (platform_config/settings.minimumVersion).

english: On a computer, reload this page. On a phone, install the latest version of {appName}.
kiswahili: Kwenye kompyuta, pakia upya ukurasa huu. Kwenye simu, sakinisha toleo jipya zaidi la {appName}.
notes: Update required screen: how to update.
